systemfields.description: Example on how to animate APEX rig procedurally using Time inside of APEX graph. It also show how to make it work with manual animation created by Scene Animate SOP. It also include several other examples on how to invoke APEX graph.

__stickynote1.text: This is example of how to invoke APEX graph with time passed as through parms dictionary. The problem with that is that I can not find a way to make ti work with scene animate and apply hand made animation.

__stickynote2.text: We pass time via detail attribute on Base.skel and then we can read it inside APEX graph. That works well with  sceneanimate and scene invoke animation. In houdini 22 there are Time and Frame APEX nodes for that.

__stickynote3.text: Simplest example of APEX graph  that adds value to a number defined as detail attribute.

__stickynote4.text:
This example show how to see actual keyframe values created in animate scene sop as geometry attribute.

By default houdini doens't expose actual keyframe transforms to users. One must use dedicated funsiont `chprim_keyvalues` and `chprim_keytimes` to extract it.

__stickynote5.text: I added nodes manualy to the graph build by autorig componets. See nodeson APEX Network View that colored in teal. The goal is to control position of Target_ik procedurally. Using Sin of Time in this case.

HoudiniVersion("21.0.365")

rigname: String = BindInput()
character: Geometry = BindInput()

# HEADER_TEMPLATE: 2
# END: <HEADER>
# Apply your manual changes here: 

from apexscript import *

def bonedeform_component(graph: ApexGraphHandle,
                    name: String = 'bonedeformation',
                    restgeo: String = 'Base.shp',
                    restskeleton: String = 'Base.skel',
                    animatedskeleton: String = 'pointtransform:geo',
                    outputgeo: String = 'Base.shp',
                    group: String = '*',
                    method: Int = 0,
                    promoterestskel: Bool = True,
                    promoterestgeo: Bool = True,
                    promoteoutputgeo: Bool = True,
                    deletecaptureattrib: Bool = True,
                    useopencl: Bool = False,
                    
                    ):
    animatedskeleton = animatedskeleton.patternRename('*.*', '*:*')
    nodedata = animatedskeleton.split(':')
    nodename = nodedata[0]
    portname = nodedata[1]

    bonedeform = graph.addOrUpdateNode(callback='sop::bonedeform',
                                   name=name,
                                   color=(.6,0,1),
                                   parms={'deletecaptureattrib':deletecaptureattrib,
                                          'donormal':1,  
                                          'method':method,
                                          'useopencl':useopencl})

    node = graph.findNode(nodename)
    nodeport = graph.findPort(node, f'{portname}[out]')
    nodeport.connect(bonedeform.geoinput2_in)

    if promoterestskel:
        restnode = graph.addOrUpdateNode(callback='Value<Geometry>',
                                     name='rest_promote',
                                     color=(.6,0,1))
        restnode.parm_in.promote(restskeleton)
    
        restnode.value_out.connect(bonedeform.geoinput1)
    if promoterestgeo:
        bonedeform.geoinput0_in.promote(restgeo)
    if promoteoutputgeo:
        bonedeform.geo_out.promote(outputgeo)
    return graph


# Parameters ====================================================================
prefix: String = BindInput('', preset_kwargs={'joins_with_next': 1})
name: String = BindInput('Bonedeformation')
animatedskeleton: String = BindInput('pointtransform:geo', preset_kwargs={'label': 'Animated Skeleton'} )
restskeleton: String = BindInput('Base.skel', preset_kwargs={'joins_with_next': 1, 'label': 'Rest Skeleton'})
restgeo: String = BindInput('Base.shp', preset_kwargs={'joins_with_next': 1, 'label': 'Rest Geo'})
outputgeo: String = BindInput('Base.shp', preset_kwargs={'joins_with_next': 1, 'label': 'Output Geo'})

method: Int = BindInput(0, preset='menu', preset_kwargs={'label': 'Method', 
                                                                   'menu_items':['Linear', 
                                                                   'Dual Quaternion', 'Blend Dual Quaternion and Linear', 
                                                                   'From Imput Geometry']})
promoterestskeleton: Bool = BindInput(True, preset_kwargs={'label': 'Promote Rest Skeleton'} )
promoteresetgeo: Bool = BindInput(True, preset_kwargs={'label': 'Promote Rest Geo'} )
promoteoutputgeo: Bool = BindInput(True, preset_kwargs={'label': 'Promote Output Geo'} )
deletecaptureattribs: Bool = BindInput(True, preset_kwargs={'label': 'Delete Capture Attribs'} )
useopencl: Bool = BindInput(False, preset_kwargs={'label': 'Use OpenCL'} )

addToFolder('Settings', [method, animatedskeleton, 
                         restskeleton, promoterestskeleton, 
                         restgeo, promoteresetgeo,
                         outputgeo, promoteoutputgeo,
                         deletecaptureattribs, useopencl,
                         
                         
                         ])

graph.bonedeform_component(name=name,
                     restgeo=restgeo,
                     restskeleton=restskeleton,
                     outputgeo=outputgeo,
                     animatedskeleton=animatedskeleton,
                     method=method,
                     promoterestskel=promoterestskeleton,
                     promoterestgeo=promoteresetgeo,
                     promoteoutputgeo=promoteoutputgeo,
                     deletecaptureattrib=deletecaptureattribs,
                     useopencl=useopencl,
                     )
